trigger: a vanish/ENOENT race at the per-entry match-time open (distinct from the already-covered readdir-level and recheck-level races)
summary: no test forces a vanish/ENOENT race at match-time per-entry open

trigger: a content-preserving symlink swap timed strictly inside delete_matching_cert's own 3-syscall recheck (between fstatat-NOFOLLOW and readlinkat+fstatat-follow)
summary: recheck's own internal non-atomicity is bounded (replacement must preserve link text AND target identity to pass, so removed entry is semantically equivalent to matched one) but was previously undocumented -- now documented in a code comment (0a083a382); no test exercises a race timed inside the recheck itself
adjudication_rationale: Impact I2 (data-adjacent: an unverified identity could in principle unlink an unintended entry) is derived but the finding's own trigger/scenario proves the outcome is bounded to a semantically-equivalent deletion -- EXPOSURE E5 (rare race) with the proven-bounded outcome is why this stays SHOULD via the shared preamble's E6-adjacent reasoning (the wrong OUTCOME, deletion of a different file, is proven unable to occur for this narrow race), not a HIGH/BLOCKING derivation. The residual TEST gap (proving this by test, not just by trace) is deferred to a follow-up issue as CH-1.
